Hi Ava (Lulu team),

Thanks for turning these around. Attached is the latest pin proof (pin_proof_v4.pdf) and a PO stub for 1,500 units (po_stub_1500.pdf). Key asks below: 

- Can you confirm the print-ready file and whether v4 requires any color separation tweaks?
- Confirm production lead time if we sign off today (we’re on a hard deliver-by to the venue: morning of 2026-06-15).
- Provide expedited shipping options and cost to deliver to the Convention Center receiving dock by 06/15 AM (two-day vs overnight).
- Any risk of material/backorder on the black enamel fill? If there’s a shortfall, propose split-ship options and how you’d prioritize VIP kits.

We’re tight on timeline. If the proofs look good I’ll need a quote approval by EOD to move to priority production.

From: Ava Moreno <lulu@brandworks.com>

Date: Mon, 01 Jun 2026 13:48:22 -0700
Subject: Re: Enamel pin proofs + expedited routing for kiosk packs (deliver by 2026-06-15)

Hi Kimberly — thanks for the files. Quick summary after production review: 

- Print-ready: We can produce from pin_proof_v4 but recommend a slight tweak to the black enamel tolerance (we’ll include a masked proof). I attached v4_print_ready.pdf with our separation notes.
- Lead time: If you approve now, production is 48 hours (2 business days) to finished goods.
- Shipping: We’ve priced two expedited options to the Convention Center dock (see attached brandworks_quote_airfreight.xlsx): 
  - Priority 2-day air (door-to-dock): $1,200 (ETA 06/14 late afternoon arrival, warehouse staging)
  - Overnight air (guaranteed delivery 06/15 06:00-10:00): $2,000 (additional pallet handling fee may apply)
- Material risk: Black enamel supplier is reporting constrained pigment batches; we estimate up to a 5% shortfall on the black fill for this run. If that occurs: 
  - Option A (recommended): Produce full 1,500, ship 1,425 complete pins and 75 ‘incomplete’ pins (missing black fill) as a separate pallet. We can do a quick local rework (fill) and ship a patch kit to the venue within 3 business days.
  - Option B: Produce 1,425 complete units and hold the remaining 75 until pigment is available (adds 3–5 days).

We can accommodate split shipments to the venue. To proceed on our expedited production timeline we need written approval of the production proof + a signed PO and authorization for up to $2,000 in shipping (if you choose overnight).

Attachments: v4_print_ready.pdf, brandworks_quote_airfreight.xlsx

Best,
Ava Moreno
Account Lead — BrandWorks / Lulu Marketing
lulu@brandworks.com
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>

Marissa / Ben — forwarding Ava’s note. TL;DR: 48h production if we sign off, shipping options 2-day ($1,200) or overnight ($2,000). Vendor flags up to 5% black-fill shortfall; recommends producing full quantity and sending 75 incomplete as a separate pallet for on-site rework or a patch kit.

Questions I need quick answers on:
- Do we approve the slight tolerance tweak on black enamel? (Vendor says it’s safe and they’ll mask in separation; attached proof looks fine to me.)
- Approve overnight air ($2,000) vs 2-day ($1,200). If venue can accept staged arrival 06/14 late afternoon for staging, we can do the 2-day and save $800.
- If shortfall happens, ok to accept split-ship + patch kit, prioritizing VIP kits (first 100 kits should be guaranteed complete).

Ben — can you provisionally approve up to $2,000 shipping (charge to Event Ops budget) so we don’t lose the priority spot? If you need a PO number I’ve attached the stub.

I’ll need a decision by 12:00pm today so BrandWorks can start production.

—Kim

Thanks Kim — approve the slight black tolerance tweak (trusted vendor). Approve overnight if Ben signs off on the $2,000 charge; otherwise we accept 2-day and will schedule venue staging for 06/14.

Ben — please approve up to $2,000 today if Event Ops budget can absorb it; mark PO as HS-50021 in the notes. Also please cc venue logistics (logistics@conventioncenter.com) so they have the pallet counts and ASN template (attached). Priority request: first 100 VIP kits must be fully complete.
